# Ryan Chi (Mr.RC)

> Ryan Chi, also known as Mr.RC, is a GTM hacker and artist who works between the United States, Dubai, Hong Kong and London. This is his personal site: https://www.ryanchi.com/

- Cofounder & co-CEO of insiders.bot, a prediction-markets aggregator for trading and copy-trading on Polymarket (exited October 2026).
- CMO & cofounder of Academic Labs (raised $3.2M; peak valuation of $350M before he left); founding member of City Protocol, now an advisor; cofounder of Showtime Watch and Sigmaboy.ai.
- Education: The Chinese University of Hong Kong (Global Business & Computer Science); exchange at the Wharton School (University of Pennsylvania) and EDHEC Business School; Head Boy at Malvern College Hong Kong.
- Former president of 0xU, a Hong Kong university blockchain club; member of FranklinDAO (Penn Blockchain).
- Writes on X as @MrRyanChi about prediction markets, quantitative trading and Web3 strategy.
- Not the same person as Ryan A. Chi, the AI researcher (ryanachi.com).
